reason: Existing v3 supports silhouette/lowlight recoloring and the original open-hand pose; no confirmed new pose or extreme magnification requires redraw yet.

recipe.lowlight: sRGB weighted luma 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B; map 0..255 to #040F19..#18313F; preserve alpha
recipe.hand: Pale-skin connected component in source ROI; fill closed crease holes, 0.6px alpha feather, copy original RGB. Body is complementary alpha-over layer.
recipe.native_closeup: Crop isolated hand bbox and add 128px clear padding, no resampling
